title: Chern's Conjecture (Affine Geometry)
exact_target: Must every compact manifold without boundary that has affine coordinate changes have zero Euler characteristic?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1375 (GEOM-016). CC BY 4.0.
